camel_example: aliyun live UpdateLivePackageConfig --region cn-hangzhou --StreamName StreamName --DomainName 'example.com' --RegionId 'cn-hangzhou' --Protocol HLS_CMAF --SegmentNum 3 --SegmentDuration 5 --AppName AppName
description_en: Updates the live streaming container format configuration
description_zh: 调用UpdateLivePackageConfig更新直播封装配置
kebab_example: aliyun live update-live-package-config --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --domain-name example.com --app-name AppName --stream-name StreamName --protocol HLS_CMAF --segment-num 3 --segment-duration 5 --region cn-hangzhou
name: UpdateLivePackageConfig

parameters.help_en: The live domain name (primary streaming domain)
parameters.name: domain_name

parameters.help_en: The application name. The template takes effect only when the AppName matches the AppName in the ingest URL. The value can be up to 255 characters in length and can contain digits, letters, hyphens (-), and underscores (_). A hyphen or underscore cannot be the first character. You can also set this parameter to an asterisk (*) to match all application names
parameters.help_zh: AppName 名称与推流地址中的 AppName 名称对应，模板才能生效。不超过255字符，支持数字、大小写字母、短横线（-）、下划线（_），短横线、下划线不能位于首位。也支持取值为单个星号（*）字符，即可匹配所有AppName
parameters.name: app_name

parameters.help_en: The stream name. The template takes effect only when the StreamName matches the StreamName in the ingest URL. The value can be up to 255 characters in length and can contain digits, letters, hyphens (-), and underscores (_). A hyphen or underscore cannot be the first character. You can also set this parameter to an asterisk (*) to match all stream names
parameters.help_zh: StreamName 名称与推流地址中的 StreamName 名称对应，模板才能生效。不超过255字符，支持数字、大小写字母、短横线（-）、下划线（_），短横线、下划线不能位于首位。也支持取值为单个星号（*）字符，即可匹配所有StreamName
parameters.name: stream_name

parameters.help_en:
The live streaming protocol and container format. Valid values:

HLS_CMAF

LLHLS_TS
(low latency)

LLHLS_CMAF (low latency)
DASH_CMAF
HLSDASH_CMAF
parameters.help_zh:
直播协议与封装格式。取值：

HLS_CMAF

LLHLS_TS
（低延迟）

LLHLS_CMAF（低延迟）
DASH_CMAF
HLSDASH_CMAF
parameters.name: protocol

parameters.help_en: The number of M3U8 segments for live streaming. Valid values: 3 to 10
parameters.help_zh: 直播M3U8切片个数。取值范围：3～10
parameters.name: segment_num

parameters.help_en:
The segment length, in seconds.

If Protocol is set to HLS_CMAF, valid values are 1 to 10.

If Protocol is set to LLHLS_*, valid values are 1 to 2
parameters.help_zh:
切片时长，单位：秒。

如Protocol为HLS_CMAF，取值范围1～10s。

如Protocol为LLHLS_*，取值范围1～2s
parameters.name: segment_duration

parameters.help_en:
The part segment length, in milliseconds.

This parameter is required when Protocol is set to LLHLS_*.
If SegmentDuration is set to 1, valid values are 100 to 500.
If SegmentDuration is set to 2, valid values are 100 to 1000
parameters.help_zh:
Part切片时长，单位：毫秒。

当Protocol为LLHLS_*时，该参数为必填项。
SegmentDuration为1s时，取值范围100～500ms。
SegmentDuration为2s时，取值范围100～1000ms
parameters.name: part_duration

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to ignore transcoded streams. Valid values:

true (default): Ignores transcoded streams.

false: Does not ignore transcoded streams
parameters.help_zh:
是否忽略转码流，取值：

true（默认值）：忽略。

false：不忽略
parameters.name: ignore_transcode
